title: DominationAL Mod
description: Adds Custom Items, Dimensions, Biomes and Advancements!
body:
# 🌌 DominationAL Mod

DominationAL Mod is a content-packed Minecraft mod created **entirely by a single developer**. Every dimension, biome, ore, item, progression system, tool, armor set, and feature is designed and developed by one person.

The mod expands your Minecraft adventure with new dimensions, biomes, powerful equipment, progression systems, collectibles, boosters, and legendary endgame content.

Explore mysterious worlds, discover rare materials, unlock stronger tiers of gear, collect ancient treasures, and master the ultimate **Beast Progression** system.

DominationAL Mod is designed to create a long-term adventure experience with constantly expanding progression paths and new challenges.

---

# 👤 Single Developer Project

DominationAL Mod is a passion project developed completely by **one developer**.

All content is created independently, including:

* 🌍 World generation
* 🧭 Custom dimensions
* ⛏️ Ores and progression systems
* ⚔️ Weapons, tools, and armor
* 🧱 Blocks and building materials
* 📖 Advancement systems
* 💠 Boosters and abilities
* 🐉 Beast Progression

Every update represents new features, improvements, and expansions created from the ground up.

---

Every biome is connected to specific dimensions, creating unique exploration routes and progression opportunities.

# 🧭 Custom Dimensions

Travel through powerful and dangerous realms:

* Domination Dimension
* Heaven
* Hell
* Shadow Dimension (Void Dimension)
* Zephyra Dimension

Each dimension introduces unique environments, resources, challenges, and progression opportunities.

The **Zephyra Dimension** is accessed through the **Zephyra Portal Igniter** and features floating landscapes, wind-based environments, and exclusive materials.

# 📖 Beast Progression

The **Beast Progression** introduces a collectible crafting system focused on long-term progression.

## Beast Pages

* Wood Page
* Stone Page
* Iron Page
* Copper Page
* Diamond Page
* Domination Page
* Void Page
* Emerald Page
* Netherite Page
* Ultimate Page
* Ultra Beast Page

## Progression System

Most Beast Pages require the previous Beast Page in their crafting recipe, creating a natural progression from the weakest to the strongest tier.

Exceptions:

* **Wood Page** is the first page and requires a Beast Gem instead of another Beast Page.
* **Copper Page** can be crafted using only copper/bronze materials.
* **Ultra Beast Page** is the final collectible and requires every Beast Page except Copper Page.

# 🏆 Ancient Progression System

Discover the ancient power hidden throughout the world.

Earn **Ancient Fragments** through:

* Advancements
* Trading with the Armorer

Progression:

Ancient Fragments → Ancient Ingots → Almighty Armor

---

# 💰 Coin & Trading System

A complete currency system for progression.

Coins include:

* Copper Coin
* Iron Coin
* Gold Coin
* Diamond Coin

Coins can be traded with the Armorer to obtain valuable Ancient Fragments.

Every update is created from the ground up with the goal of making DominationAL Mod a bigger, deeper, and more unique Minecraft adventure.
